name: Kak 2D-tyan popala v Omsk
source:
An unremarkable guy living an unremarkable life in an unremarkable Siberian town. That's the whole story… or so he thought.

But one day, through utterly inexplicable circumstances, a 2D girl straight out of an anime tumbles into our world.

Our hero is a grown man who lost faith in pretty much everything a long time ago - including his own future. But the arrival of this anime girl slowly starts to drag him out of his apathy, reminding him how to find joy in the little things again. However, with joy comes danger... The girl attracts more than just our attention: a hunt for both her and us begins.

Throughout your adventures, you'll face choice after choice - how to act, what to say, who to be. And the girl? She remembers everything. Every decision you make shapes who your hero becomes… and decides the ending you'll reach.
After all, you're the one holding his fate in your hands.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4621090/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个不起眼的人在一个不起眼的西伯利亚小镇过着不起眼的生活。这就是整个故事……至少他是这么想的。

但有一天，在完全令人费解的情况下，一位直接从动漫中走出来的2D女孩跌入了我们的世界。

我们的英雄是一个成年人，他很久以前就对几乎所有事情都失去了信心——包括他自己的未来。但这个动漫女孩的到来慢慢开始把他从冷漠中拉出来，提醒他如何再次在小事中找到快乐。然而，快乐也伴随着危险……这个女孩吸引的不仅仅是我们的注意力：对她和我们的追捕开始了。

在你的冒险过程中，你将面临一个又一个的选择——如何行动、说什么、成为谁。那女孩呢？她记得一切。你做出的每一个决定都会塑造你的英雄……并决定你将达到的结局。
毕竟，你才是掌握他命运的人。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4621090/]Steam[/url]]
